The skill guides a read-only (allowed-tools: Read, Grep, Glob) privacy/data-governance review of AI systems: training-data PII, PII in prompts/completions, retention, memorization, EU AI Act Art. 10, and consent, with Glob/Grep search patterns, severity tables and a report template.
